You are a desktop user (desktop, 1440x950).

Play a multiplayer movie-guessing game together with the other players in one shared lobby. Keep playing rounds until the game ends. Do not stop to narrate; keep taking actions until the game is over.

Lane focus: Create a multiplayer lobby, pick a display name, and wait in the waiting room. THE ONE RULE: do not press Start until you can SEE at least five other player names listed in the waiting room. They take several minutes to arrive one by one, and a mostly empty room for a long time is normal. While waiting, only re-check the player list. Starting early ruins the game. Once five or more other names are visible, wait one more minute for stragglers, then start the game and play every round to the end.

When you stop, make the FIRST line of your last message exactly one of these three, on its own line: REACHED THE GOAL. / DID NOT REACH THE GOAL. / BLOCKED. Then, from the next line, say what you did, what confused you, and where you hesitated.
